name: Thymosin alpha-1

typical_dose_shape.note: No FDA-approved dosing reference exists for this compound. This range describes reported use and is not a recommendation.

description: A synthetic peptide identical to a naturally occurring thymic hormone, approved in several countries outside the United States as thymalfasin for hepatitis B and as a vaccine adjuvant. It has no FDA approval and appears on the FDA Category 2 bulk-substances list. Approved in some non-US jurisdictions as thymalfasin. No FDA approval; on the FDA 503A Category 2 bulk drug substances list.

systems.note: Immunomodulation of T-cell maturation is the intended effect.
Studied in hepatitis but without US labelling; hepatic effect at these doses is uncharacterised in an approved setting.
